card.name: Digits inside ISSN and ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (often 6, 7, 8 or 9) in the middle of a long identifier number such as an ISSN, eISSN, ISBN or DOI in a reference list. It also fires on digits inside other long numbers.

modes.label: Journal and book identifiers
modes.description: A middle digit inside an ISSN, eISSN, ISBN or DOI in a citation.

modes.label: Other long numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a long figure or volume number in a citation or measurement.

card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a long catalogue number, like an ISSN or ISBN in a reference list.
